## Circular to Licensed Corporations

which are Participants of Hong Kong Futures Exchange Limited

## Compliance with the Securities and Futures (Insurance) Rules

Following  our  circular  of  29  March  2004  regarding  the  Licence  Holders  Insurance Scheme for the year 2004/2005, you should have by now received the debit note from Aon Hong Kong Limited ('Aon') requesting your payment of the insurance premium for  the  period  from  1  April  2004  to  31  March  2005  inclusive  (unless  you  have formally notified us of the cessation of your dealing business effective before 1 April 2004). Please  promptly  respond  to  the  debit  note  by  paying  the  insurance premium to Aon without delay if you have not already done so.

As set out in the above circular, you are obliged to take out and maintain insurance under the approved master policy of insurance.  This obligation is a statutory licensing condition which you must comply with as a licensed corporation under the Securities and Futures Ordinance.  Failure to do so will result in your breaching the licensing condition.  This may render you subject to possible disciplinary actions.

Please note that there will be no refund of insurance premium for participants exiting the industry during the insurance period.

If you have any queries on the insurance scheme, you may contact Aon at 2861-6410.

## Licensing Department
